defect_found_and_fixed_before_integratio.finding: SQLite fires DELETE triggers for the implicit delete of INSERT OR REPLACE only when PRAGMA recursive_triggers is ON, and its default is OFF. A raw INSERT OR REPLACE reusing a stored operation_id or digest therefore deleted a historical row while events_no_delete stayed silent.
defect_found_and_fixed_before_integratio.source: adversarial review workflow wf_5f54e14c-28b, schema lens, confirmed by its refutation agent
defect_found_and_fixed_before_integratio.fix: new trigger events_no_replace: BEFORE INSERT, aborts when the row reuses a stored sequence, operation_id or digest
defect_found_and_fixed_before_integratio.proof: both attacks refused on a migrated 415-event copy with the table unchanged at 415 rows; regression test insert_or_replace_cannot_delete_history_test
secondary_fixes: journal_mode and foreign_keys are read back and the open is refused unless effective (an unchecked PRAGMA can silently leave rollback-journal mode)
verify's per-check booleans are typed counters instead of substring matches over text that embeds caller-supplied operation_ids

residual_gap.finding: A raw SQL INSERT that extends the chain correctly but stores a digest not equal to sha256(body_json) is accepted by the triggers. It is caught by verify (digest_ok false, exact sequence named) and by replay, which fails closed, but the triggers alone do not stop it.
residual_gap.status: recorded, not fixed; a trigger cannot compute sha256
